content.text:
Found three concrete issues.

- High · UI correctness · [AssistantChatPanel.tsx:2373](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/components/AssistantChatPanel.tsx:2373), [useKeatingAgent.tsx:895](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/hooks/useKeatingAgent.tsx:895), [session-recovery.ts:47](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/hooks/session-recovery.ts:47)  
  “Choose model and retry” is normally a no-op. An image endpoint exception becomes an errored tool result; the agent then completes a normal follow-up assistant message. The callback invokes `prepareMessagesForRetry`, which only retries when the *last* message has `stopReason: error|aborted`; the usual trailing assistant message has `stopReason: stop`, so it returns `null`. The picker saves the model but performs no retry and gives no feedback. Confidence: high.

- Medium · UI correctness · [ModelSelector.tsx:677](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/components/ModelSelector.tsx:677), [image-generators.ts:42](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/lib/image-generators.ts:42)  
  The retry picker cannot recover local OpenAI-compatible image generation. That generator intentionally declares `models: []` for free-form model IDs, but `ImageGenerationModelSelectorDialog` derives all choices exclusively from that array. Clicking the retry control after a local-model failure yields an empty dialog with a disabled action—no way to select or enter another model.

- Medium · Test coverage · [model-capabilities.test.ts:25](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/test/model-capabilities.test.ts:25)  
  The added test only covers pure capability predicates. There is no test referencing the new picker/retry components or `onImageGenerationModelSelect`, so the failed retry transition and the local free-form model case are untested. Focused existing tests pass (10/10), but do not cover these UI paths.

No concrete introduced issues found for refactoring needed, duplicate code, poor naming, or request-artifact leftovers.
